calendar.name: Calendar | Calendars
calendar.hint: On the calendar you can move your events and task. Task can in addition be extended if you grab the event at the end. If you double click on a date you can create new ToDo. If you click on an event you get more info and can set the status.

company.name: Company | Companies
company.title: Here you can change your between your companies or create new ones. As admin you can also edit the name of your company or delete one.
company.titleUser: Here you can see a list of users who have access to the current company. Remove them, change access rights or add new ones.
company.changeName: Enter a new name for your company (min: 5, max: 45)
company.new: Enter name for your new company (min: 5, max: 45). Note: You will need to pay for each new company premium access separately.
company.delete: Are you sure you want to delete the company? This is only possible if it is not your last company and no other users are registered with this company. For security please repeat the name of the company:
company.removeAccess: Are you sure you want to remove your access to this company? This is only possible if you are not the sole user in this company and if it is not your only company. For security please repeat the name of the company:
company.addUser: Enter email of user. If the new user is not already registered, she/he will receive an email to reset her/his password to successfully login.

recoverUser.title: Recover lost password
recoverUser.text: Enter the e-mail address by which you registered your user account. You will receive an email with instructions on how to reset your password.
recoverUser.success: We send you an e-mail ({msg}) to reset your password, if you dont get the mail in a few minutes it could be that no account with this address is registered. Otherwise please feel free to contact us at {'office@btree.at'}

resetUser.title: Create new password
resetUser.success: Your password was successfully changed, we sent a confirmation mail to {msg}.
resetUser.label: Reset Key

unsubscribe.name: Unsubscribe

profile.name: Profile | Profiles
profile.userTitle: Here you can update your user settings.
profile.credentialTitle: Update your login credentials, for security reasons please also insert your old password.
profile.apiTitle: Premium members can access the API, please see documentation for more information.
profile.userDeleteText: Are you sure you want to delete your account? This action cannot be undone. Note: If there are another user in the current company the company data wont be deleted otherwise all data will be removed. For security please enter your current password.

map.name: Map | Maps
map.hint: You can move your apiary to a new location by drag and drop! Double click on map to create a new apiary!
map.move: Are you sure you want to move your apiary ({msg}) to a new location?

setting.name: Setting | Settings
setting.title: Here you can select or deselect fields you want to be shown in your Quicktool!
setting.hintCheckupRating: Rating: 6 Input Fields - Brood, Pollen, Comb Building, Temper, Calm Comb, Swarm
setting.hintCheckupQueen: Queen: 4 Checkboxes - Queen, Queen Cells, Eggs, Capped Brood
setting.hintCheckupWeight: Weight: 1 Input and Time Field for weight value
setting.hintCheckupTemperature: Temperature: 1 Input Field, for Premium user it will load automatically the current temperature on select hive or apiary
setting.hintCheckupVarroa: Varroa: 1 Input Field for Varroa Count
setting.hintCheckupFrames: Frames: 4 Input Fields - Broodframes, Honeyframes, Foundationframes, Emptyframes
setting.hintHarvestWater: Water: 1 Input Field for water content %
setting.hintHarvestFrames: Frames: 1 Input Field for how many frames you harvested.
setting.hintTreatmentWait: Wait: 1 Input Field, for waiting time after treatment
setting.hintTreatmentVet: Vet: 1 Dropdown, in the Options you can define the values for this dropdown
setting.hintChargePrice: Price: 1 Input Field, for a price
setting.hintChargeBestbefore: Best before: 1 Date Field, to be used for best before date
setting.hintChargeCalibrate: Calibrate: 1 Input Field, if you want to keep a calibrate list for you charges
